notes: This is a non-fiction National Geographic reader about the human body. Fringe vocabulary focuses on key body systems and organs that students will encounter throughout the book. 'Strong' serves as a useful descriptive/feeling word tied to muscles and body concepts. All selected words are highly picturable in standard Boardmaker symbol libraries. The hero slot uses a generic human body outline which Boardmaker covers adequately — no custom sourcing needed. Teachers may wish to supplement with actual photos from the book if students respond better to realistic images than symbols for anatomy content.
